summary: The LiveKit Startup Program provides up to $23K: one year of Cloud Scale free ($6K value, $500/mo waived), $10K in additional LiveKit Cloud credits, and $7K in inference credits ($1K with each participating partner — Deepgram, Inworld, Rime, Fish Audio, AssemblyAI, Gradium, plus Gemma 4 31B hosted by LiveKit). Credits expire 12 months from issuance. Eligibility: voice/video/physical AI core to the product, <50 employees, <$5M raised and pre-Series A ($5M+ case-by-case), live website with identifiable founding team, in production or launching within 6 months. A card on file is required to enroll. Applicants must be incorporated or actively incorporating and building for real end-users. The program targets net-new startup projects: free-plan evaluators/builders can apply, while projects running for a while or already paying/contractually committed may be declined and reviewed case by case.
claim_steps: Confirm the startup is incorporated or actively incorporating, is building for real end-users, and meets the net-new project rules; existing paid/committed users should explain their circumstances in the application.
Apply via the form at https://livekit.com/startups (no pitch deck required).
On approval you receive a promo code by email; enter it at checkout when starting your Cloud Scale plan.
A card on file is required to enroll. Credits expire 12 months from issuance.
YC-backed companies should apply at livekit.com/yc instead — offers cannot be combined.

social_proof.title: LiveKit net-new project eligibility
social_proof.text: The program is built for net-new startup projects, so teams on the free plan using LiveKit to evaluate or build are welcome to apply. We may decline projects that have been running on LiveKit for a while, or that are already paying or contractually committed customers.
